def look_and_say_sequence(start_string, n):
    if n == 1:
        return start_string
    current_string = start_string
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        next_string = ""
        i = 0
        while i < len(current_string):
            count = 1
            while i + 1 < len(current_string) and current_string[i] == current_string[i + 1]:
                i += 1
                count += 1
            next_string += str(count) + current_string[i]
            i += 1
        current_string = next_string
    return current_string
